observations.title: Curios API role and integration boundary
observations.player_action: Use the consuming mod's interface or feature; this component's own installation is not a survival objective.
observations.outcome: Adds a common accessory inventory and slot API. Slots are created by consumers, item compatibility uses tags, and installing Curios alone does not define the pack's accessory progression.
conditions: Exact installed artifact metadata was inspected; current author pages can cover newer versions.
No runtime behavior or benchmark was verified; do not change installed configuration from these research notes.
observations.review_note: Installed static role is corroborated by the artifact/resource/SHA256 attached to the source. Public URL identifies the upstream project, not a claim that a missing web guide was read. Multiple packaged versions remain loader-resolution candidates: ${file.jarVersion}

observations.title: Equip a supported accessory
observations.player_action: Open the Curios inventory from the native inventory interface and place a compatible accessory into a provided slot.
observations.outcome: The consuming mod's slot definition and item tags determine admission and active accessory behavior; an inventory item alone does not prove that it was equipped.
conditions: Follow the installed consumer and server configuration; exact default keybindings and optional integration behavior were not runtime-verified.
